newsitem.title: FINLAND: Baltic Ice- Ice steady, restrictions unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Baltic Ice- Ice steady, restrictions unchanged.

text.p: Ice levels were little changed and there were no planned changes to restrictions to navigation, the Finnish Institute of Marine Research said in its twice-weekly ice report on Monday.
Three icebreakers were assisting near St Petersburg and Vyborg in the eastern Gulf of Finland, one near Loviisa, five in the northern end of the Gulf of Bothnia and two in the middle.
One ice-breaker remained on station outside Parnu in the Gulf of Riga, the institute said.

NOTES: New ice - forming, thin and still moving. Fast ice - not moving level flat ice. Level ice - thick flat ice. Consolidated/compact - compact close ice. Windrow ice - reshaped by wind, thickness varies sharply. Rafted - ridges forming, 10-20 cm thick. Ridged - ridged or hummocked ice. Open - floes with water at rate of 4-6:10. Close ice - floes tightly packed.
